name: Commerce Sell Once
description: A Commerce Stock service (tagged commerce_stock.stock_service) that caps a purchasable entity to a single sale. It adds a boolean base field commerce_sell_once_sold to every product-variation type; the stock checker reports 1 unit while the flag is FALSE and 0 once it is TRUE, and a stock-decrement transaction flips the flag to sold (a positive/restock transaction clears it). Actual add-to-cart/checkout blocking is performed by Commerce Stock's availability layer and requires the Commerce Stock Enforcement submodule. Ships no settings form, permission, or Drush; provides a transaction event and an uninstall-cleanup form.
project_description: A Commerce Stock service that will only allow a product to be sold one time.
